title: kith-tui: trust system TLS roots when --cert is omitted
description: reqwest is built with rustls-tls-manual-roots and build_client trusts only the pinned --cert. To reach chinwag behind a proxy with a public cert (IIW demo 2026-11-03), make --cert optional and use system/webpki roots when absent.
close_reason: --cert optional; system roots when omitted; live-checked against public host, pinning still rejects other issuers
